1. Present petition has been filed under Section 483 of Bnss, 2023 (earlier Section 439 Cr.P.C.), for
grant of regular bail to the petitioner, during the pendency of trial, who has been booked in a
criminal case arising out of First Information Report, as detailed here-under:-

Name of FIR Date Section(s) Police Station District Petitioner(s) No. Kashish 11 08.08.2023 120-B, 182, 199, 200, 211, 384 Punjab State SAS Uppal alias & 420 of IPC Crime Police Nagar Sofia Uppal [S. 388, 389, 465, 467, 468, Station 471 of IPC,
added later on]

2. The primary allegation against the petitioner is that she has been falsely implicating individuals in criminal cases involving offences, such as rape, moral turpitude, outraging the modesty of women and under the POCSO Act.
3. In the present case, on 19.12.2025, following order was passed:-

"1. In paragraph No.4 of the status report dated 09.12.2025, it is stated that during an investigation conducted by AIG, Crime Zone, 1 of 2 Amritsar, it was revealed that one Veronika alias Divyanshi Kanwar, in connivance with the petitioner, had registered multiple cases in the States of Punjab and Delhi with the ulterior motive of extorting money from individuals by making false allegations of rape against them.
